comment: One row for each rule of the universe function `regrow` (D12.2) outside the runtime, whose rows
tools/mutations/rt_fort.json holds. The rows cover the checker (check_regrow in
src/fort/check.ft), the lowering (lower_regrow in src/fort/fir_lower.ft), the rules V4 and V6 of
the rvalue `regrow` (src/fort/fir_verify.ft and rvalue_owns in src/fort/fir.ft), the translation
(regrow_value in src/fort/fir_llvm.ft), the reference interpreter (regrow_from, regrow_back and
move_owners in src/fort/fir/interpreter.ft), and the prover. The prover has no line for
`regrow`: it reads the `move` of the operand in gen_reads and a store of a value that is not
zero in apply_store, and apply_call reads a `call` only. Each row D12.2-prove-* adds a wrong
reading of `regrow` to one of these three, and owner/prover_regrow_test.ft catches it. The first
stage runs the module suites, which compile the mutated sources themselves. The second stage
runs each program of test/lang whose name holds `regrow`. The table runs in the VM with the
default runner after `tools/vm configure` and `tools/vm build`. The md5 guard reads the product
build: sleep 2 && touch src/fort/check.ft src/fort/fir.ft src/fort/fir_lower.ft src/fort/fir_verify.ft src/fort/fir_llvm.ft src/fort/fir/interpreter.ft src/fort/owner/prover.ft && ninja -C build/Linux/debug fort
